jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Owner | PGIM Ireland
jobs.description:
Job Overview
PGIM Technology is seeking a Senior Director, Product Owner – Finance & HR Technology to lead a portfolio of technology products and platforms supporting Finance, Human Resources, and enterprise reporting capabilities. This leader will partner with senior business and technology stakeholders to shape strategy, advance modernization, and deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency, workforce insights, reporting, and organizational effectiveness across PGIM.
Working in Letterkenny in a hybrid format, you will combine product management expertise, business acumen, and technology leadership experience to deliver measurable outcomes in a complex enterprise environment. The role requires a leader who can translate business needs into pragmatic technology strategy, influence across functions, and guide delivery teams from concept through execution and continuous improvement.

What You Can Expect
- Define and execute the technology strategy and product roadmap supporting Finance and Human Resources capabilities.
- Partner closely with senior stakeholders to identify opportunities for innovation, automation, process simplification, and operational improvement.
- Lead cross-functional teams responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and resilient technology solutions.
- Drive modernization efforts across enterprise reporting, workforce analytics, and business management platforms.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to business leadership while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data, risk, and security standards.

What You Will Do
Product Strategy & Leadership
- Establish and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Finance and HR technology solutions.
- Align product investments with business priorities, enterprise objectives, and organizational goals.
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to identify opportunities for innovation and value creation.
- Partner with business leaders to define success measures and ensure realization of expected outcomes.

Stakeholder Partnership
- Build strong relationships across Finance, Human Resources, Data & Analytics, Risk, Compliance, and Technology organizations.
- Act as a primary technology partner for functional leadership teams.
- Facilitate prioritization decisions and investment planning across competing business demands.
- Communicate product direction, delivery progress, risks, and opportunities to executive leadership.

Delivery & Transformation
- Lead end-to-end product delivery from strategy through implementation and continuous improvement.
- Drive Agile product management practices across distributed delivery teams.
- Oversee product backlogs, release planning, execution priorities, and delivery commitments.
- Champion transformation initiatives focused on process automation, analytics, reporting modernization, and operational efficiency.

Data, Reporting & Analytics
- Lead technology capabilities supporting financial reporting, workforce insights, organizational planning, and management reporting.
- Partner with data teams to improve accessibility, quality, governance, and utilization of business information.
- Enable data-driven decision making through modern reporting and analytics solutions.
- Support enterprise initiatives focused on improving operational transparency and business performance measurement.

Operational & Risk Management
- Ensure technology solutions meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, resiliency, and operational excellence.
- Manage vendor relationships and third-party service providers as needed.
- Monitor technology health, adoption, and value realization metrics.
- Drive continuous improvement across platforms, processes, and delivery practices.

What You'll Need
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
- 10+ years of experience leading enterprise technology products, applications, or platforms.
- Demonstrated experience partnering with Finance, Human Resources, or corporate functions.
- Experience leading complex technology initiatives and organizational transformation programs.
- Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and product management principles.
- Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
- Proven ability to influence decision-making across business and technology organizations.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in financial services, asset management, insurance, banking, or another regulated industry.
- Experience supporting Workday, enterprise reporting, workforce analytics, or financial management platforms.
- Knowledge of cloud technologies, data platforms, analytics, and automation capabilities.
- Experience leading geographically distributed teams and external partners.
- Familiarity with Power BI, Azure, modern integration architectures, and enterprise data management practices.

What Will Set You Apart
- Ability to translate complex business challenges into scalable technology solutions.
- Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution leadership.
- Passion for driving innovation and delivering measurable business outcomes.
- Demonstrated success building high-performing teams and fostering collaborative partnerships.
- Track record of leading enterprise modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

What we offer you
- Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses.

- Annual Leave of 23 days at full pay.

- Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme.

- Annual Bonus Programme & Shop LK Vouchers / CleverCards (subject to eligibility): Along with an annual bonus employees are rewarded with Shop LK Vouchers/ CleverCards which are paid tax free.

- Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary.

- Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education.

Why PGIM Technology?
At PGIM Technology, you will have the opportunity to solve complex business challenges while helping shape the future of our enterprise technology landscape. You will work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous learning, and leadership at every level.
This role offers the opportunity to influence strategic business outcomes, lead meaningful transformation initiatives, and deliver technology solutions that create lasting value for the organization.
- PGIM Ireland is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of applicants’ gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race or membership of the traveler community. PGIM Ireland's aim is to hire the best people for the open roles and all appointments will be made on merit.

Any offer of employment made by PGIM Ireland will be contingent on receiving satisfactory references. Applicants should be aware that background checks will be carried out on all candidates offered a position within PGIM Ireland.

jobs.title: Director, AI Product & MarTech Enablement
jobs.description:
Job Classification:
Project Mgmt, Transformation & Strategy - Project Mgmt, Transformation & Strategy

The Opportunity

Marketing is being reinvented around intelligent platforms, trusted data, and AI. Our MarTech, AI & Data Strategy team owns the capabilities that make that possible — and the AI Product & MarTech Enablement pillar is where new AI capability meets everyday marketing execution.

The Director, AI Product & MarTech   Enablement,   leads this pillar. You will own two connected mandates: bringing AI into marketing — the use cases, decisioning, and orchestration that make campaigns smarter and faster — and driving MarTech enablement, so the organization gets maximum value from every platform it runs. You'll turn emerging AI from experiment into production-grade product, and you'll make the MarTech stack easier to adopt, better supported, and demonstrably more valuable.   You'll operate in a highly matrixed environment as the alignment hub across the Enterprise Data Office, Analytics, Technology, Privacy, and Legal.

What You'll Do:

SET THE AI PRODUCT VISION AND ROADMAP

- Define and articulate a clear vision and roadmap for AI in marketing   — the use cases, decisioning, and orchestration capabilities that turn marketing into an intelligent, always-on engine.

- Champion the adoption and integration of AI   across the marketing organization to create measurable business value.

- Prioritize the AI use-case pipeline with senior leadership   — securing resources, setting priorities, and measuring performance against clear objectives.

- Serve as the subject-matter expert on applied AI for marketing   — GenAI, agentic workflows, decisioning, and orchestration — and guide the exploration of novel approaches to complex challenges.

DELIVER AI PRODUCTS FROM CONCEPT TO PRODUCTION

- Lead the design, build, and deployment of AI products and tools   — from proof-of-concept through production — meeting quality, scope, and timeline expectations.

- Oversee prompt engineering, AI tooling, and experience-intelligence capabilities   that put AI directly into marketers' hands

- Operationalize AI decisioning and orchestration across the MarTech stack , partnering with data and platform teams so models and agents are production-ready and integrated.

- Embed responsible AI practices   — transparency, fairness, and compliance with data-protection and enterprise standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

DRIVE MARTECH ENABLEMENT, ADOPTION, AND VALUE REALIZATION

- Own operational support of the MarTech tools and platforms   — keeping the stack running smoothly and marketers unblocked.

- Establish and share best practices, playbooks, and standards   that raise the bar on how the organization uses its MarTech investments.

- Drive innovation with MarTech tools   — continuously surfacing new ways to generate value for the business.

- Lead the adoption and value-realization agenda   — measurably increasing platform adoption and ensuring every MarTech investment delivers a clear return.

SUPPORT   DISCIPLINED AGILE DELIVERY

- Partner closely with Release Train Engineers (RTEs) and Scrum Masters   to ensure Program Increment (PI) planning is executed on cadence and commitments are met.

- Translate roadmap priorities into well-formed epics, features, and backlogs   — keeping delivery aligned to business value and dependencies managed across teams.

- Instill agile ways of working   — transparency, iteration, and continuous improvement — across the AI and enablement teams.

BUILD AND LEAD THE TEAM

- M entor, and   develop a high-performing team   spanning AI product, prompt engineering, AI business analysis, and MarTech enablement.

- Set clear goals, coach for growth, and cultivate a collaborative, innovative, data-driven culture   that values continuous learning.

- Manage a blend of employees and contract specialists   and oversee vendor and partner relationships — optimizing tool and API integrations and holding partners to quality, timeline, and value standards.

ENGAGE STAKEHOLDERS AND COMMUNICATE IMPACT

- Translate complex AI and technical concepts into clear business language   for senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

- Provide regular status updates, adoption metrics, and ROI analyses   that make the value of AI and MarTech investments visible.

- Operate as a trusted partner   across Marketing, Analytics, Technology, and the broader enterprise, aligning work to shared priorities.

- Align to enterprise standards   by partnering with the Enterprise Data & AI Office to keep responsible AI/ethical practices consistent with enterprise policies and frameworks.

What You Bring

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10 + years of progressive experience in MarTech / marketing technology product management, AI-ML enablement, or digital marketing platforms, including team leadership.

- Proven track record putting AI or automation into production in a business setting — from use-case identification through deployment and adoption.

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of the modern MarTech stack (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform, Marketo, SFMC, CDP) and how to drive operational support, adoption, and value realization.

- Practical fluency with applied AI for marketing — GenAI, prompt engineering, agentic/automation frameworks, and AI-driven decisioning and orchestration.

- Experience operating in an agile /   SAFe   environment — partnering with RTEs and Scrum Masters and actively participating in PI planning and execution.

- Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, and storytelling skills — able to translate technical concepts into business value and ROI.

- Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical and product teams within a matrixed organization.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in financial services, insurance, or another regulated, data-sensitive industry.

- Familiarity with responsible AI practices and data-protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

- P roduct management credentials a plus.

- Experience managing vendors and optimizing API and tool integrations across a marketing technology ecosystem.

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field — computer science, data science, marketing, business, engineering, or related; an advanced degree is a plus.

The Ideal Candidate

- A builder and an operator   — turns emerging AI capability into working products and reliable platform operations.

- A value translator   — connects tools and models to adoption, business outcomes, and ROI.

- An enabler   — makes everyone around them better at using MarTech and AI.

- A disciplined delivery leader   — thrives on agile cadence and gets PI commitments shipped.

- A responsible innovator   — pushes the frontier while keeping AI transparent, compliant, and trustworthy.

- A communicator   — makes the complex clear for any audience.

How Success Is Measured

- Adoption and active usage of MarTech platforms and AI tools across marketing.

- Value realization — measurable business impact and ROI from MarTech and AI investments.

- Speed and reliability of AI product delivery from concept to production.

- Consistency of PI planning execution and on-cadence delivery.

- Health, capability, and engagement of the team.

Work Arrangement

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Newark, NJ. The successful candidate is expected to work onsite at the Newark office three (3) days per week, with flexibility to work remotely for the balance of the week.

What we offer you:

Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $147,100.00 to $220,700.00. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. - Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level.
- Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave.
- 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%).
- Company-funded pension plan.
- Wellness Programs including up to $1,600 a year for reimbursement of items purchased to support personal wellbeing needs.
- Work/Life Resources to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matters, education, emotional and mental health, and career development.
- Education Benefit to help finance traditional college enrollment toward obtaining an approved degree and many accredited certificate programs.
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Shares can be purchased at 85% of the lower of two prices (Beginning or End of the purchase period).

Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. To find out more about our Total Rewards package, visit Work Life Balance | Prudential Careers. Some of the above benefits may not apply to part-time employees scheduled to work less than 20 hours per week.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability, marital status, age, veteran status, domestic partner status, medical condition or any other characteristic protected by law.
